description: Real generation pipelines for work boundaries and cancellation; successful counters are compared through the same C API on native and WASM.

cases.name: capture
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { pixel(0,0,#abc) }; surface.paint(image); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: sampler batch
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { values=sampler(0.0 to 1.0 with gaussian(0.5,0.15)).pick(256); state={values[255],0}; state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: stepper batch
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { values=stepper(0.0 to 1.0 with gaussian(0.5,0.15)).pick(256); state={values[255],0}; state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: noise mask
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { m = noise.mask({0,0},{64,64},noise.mode_cell_edge,{0.1,0.1},0.2,seed); surface.paint(m,#abc); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: morphology
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { rect(8,8,40,40,#abc8) }; m=mask.expand(mask.from(image),4); surface.paint(m,#abc); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: algebra
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { rect(8,8,40,40,#abc8) }; m=mask.invert(mask.from(image)); surface.paint(m,#abc); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: layer blur
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { rect(8,8,40,40,#abc8) }; surface.paint(image.blur(2.0)); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: mask blur
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { rect(8,8,40,40,#abc8) }; surface.paint(mask.from(image).blur(2.0),#abc); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: layer paint
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { rect(8,8,40,40,#abc8) }; surface.paint(image); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: mask paint
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { rect(8,8,40,40,#abc8) }; surface.paint(mask.from(image),#abc); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: polygon
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { poly(1,1,61,3,59,61,2,59, #abc8); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: curve
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { curve({1,1},{32,1},{60,60},2,#abc8); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: oval
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { oval(1,1,62,62,#abc8); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: voronoi
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { d=voronoi({0,0},{64,64},36,seed); state=diagram.site(d,0); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: contour
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { rect(4,4,56,56,#fff) }; c=contour(mask.from(image),0.5); state={regions.count(regions(c)),0}; state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: offset
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { r=regions(voronoi({0,0},{64,64},36,seed)); r=regions.gap(r,0.5); state={regions.count(r),0}; state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: region raster
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { r=regions(voronoi({0,0},{64,64},16,seed)); surface.paint(regions.mask(r),#abc); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: bevel
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { r=regions(voronoi({0,0},{64,64},16,seed)); surface.paint(regions.bevel(r,2,{-1,-1})); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: part scan
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { rect(4,4,56,56,#abc8) }; p=part.create(image); part.draw(p); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: part mask
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { rect(4,4,56,56,#abc8) }; p=part.create(image); surface.paint(part.mask(p),#abc); state = {unit(), unit()} } }

cases.name: part draw
cases.source: asset Metered { size 64x64 output point state draw { layer image(alpha=surface.source_over) { rect(4,4,56,56,#abc8) }; p=part.fill(part.create(mask.from(image)),#abc); part.draw(p); state = {unit(), unit()} } }
